status: M0 technical audit recorded; source/business/device gates remain open

account.schema_symbols: users, userProfiles, identityVerifications, authSessions, userPolicyAcceptances, phoneChangeRequests, personalDataExportJobs, accountCancellationRequests
account.admin: Identity review; policy publication; lifecycle review
account.gap: Local login and lifecycle paths exist; real identity/SMS and V3.5 adult/role/retention rules need acceptance.

catalog.schema_symbols: sellerProfiles, sellerApplications, products, productVersions, productSkus, favorites
catalog.gap: Catalog and approvals exist; no game/category model or general-item stock/delivery contract; Home and seller navigation differ.

purchase.schema_symbols: orders, orderSlotReservations, sellerAvailabilitySlots, payments, paymentEvents, idempotencyKeys
purchase.admin: Order/payment query and intervention in existing admin
purchase.gap: Current contract requires slot_id/service_starts_at and seller accept/reject. Test channels and legacy race coverage exist.

fulfillment.gap: Current complete action takes version without fulfillment evidence payload; extension/cooldown/new evidence policy require implementation.

cases.schema_symbols: refunds, refundLogs, complaints, complaintEvidences, complaintLogs; target proposals/rulings/appeals/independent holds are missing
cases.admin: Support/supervisor rulings, separated appeal review, controlled evidence
cases.gap: Legacy refunds/complaints exist; full case, proposal, supplementary, appeal and source-framework liability behavior is missing.

finance.schema_symbols: ledgerAccounts, ledgerTransactions, ledgerEntries, sellerIncomes, sellerLiabilities, withdrawals, withdrawalIncomeAllocations, reconciliationRuns
finance.admin: Withdrawal approval, reconciliation, liability handling; independent case holds need model
finance.gap: Ledger/payout/reconciliation exist. Refund commission is proportional today; V3.5 full waiver and independent holds need implementation.

reviews.admin: Review visibility/moderation; public seller replies unresolved
reviews.gap: Review paths exist; first-termination window, refunded-order eligibility/labels and public replies need reconciliation.

messaging.gap: HTTP polling text path exists. Tencent integration, authorized product/order cards, role identity, archive and native push are not established.

feedback.api: No dedicated feedback API located; do not substitute /api/v1/support-cases
feedback.admin: New dedicated handling and official-reply view required
feedback.existing_tests: No feedback-specific suite located; chat-support tests cover separate support
feedback.gap: Standalone records, history, reply workflow and notification are missing; feedback is not an after-sales case.

support.admin: Existing support workspace; special-claim intake and timestamp evidence need new-rule acceptance
support.gap: Support exists; preserve first qualifying contact, case linkage and restriction exceptions.

reliability.api: Shared command/job paths behind transaction APIs
reliability.gap: Durable primitives exist; worker currently uses LoggingPublisher; new-rule stale-job and outage behavior need implementation.

files.admin: Original/redacted evidence access, moderation/quarantine, lifecycle holds
files.existing_tests: file-storage.integration.test.mjs (not executed in this batch); file-upload.test.ts; native-voice-media.test.ts
files.gap: Existing file foundation; completion evidence immutability/redaction, OSS adapter and retention conflict remain.

quality.schema_symbols: No independent schema; consumer of current state/action contracts
quality.admin: Cross-client consistency and manual device evidence
quality.gap: Static/domain checks pass separately from native UI proof; real-device and web behavior remain unverified in M0.
